name: nested-order
grammar: grammar Invalid { @package: commonprobe @root @mapping(Node) @commonField(value) Root ::= A | B; @nestedCaptures @mapping(A,params=[value]) A ::= 'a' [ {'x'} ] @value; @nestedCaptures @mapping(B,params=[value]) B ::= 'b' { ['x'] } @value;  }

name: nested-node
grammar: grammar Invalid { @package: commonprobe @root @mapping(Node) @commonField(value) Root ::= A | B; @nestedCaptures @mapping(A,params=[value]) A ::= 'a' [Leaf] @value; @nestedCaptures @mapping(B,params=[value]) B ::= 'b' [Other] @value; @mapping(Leaf,params=[text]) Leaf ::= 'x' @text; @mapping(Other,params=[text]) Other ::= 'x' @text; }

name: nested-enum
grammar: grammar Invalid { @package: commonprobe @root @mapping(Node) @commonField(value) Root ::= A | B; @nestedCaptures @mapping(A,params=[value]) A ::= 'a' [Mode] @value; @nestedCaptures @mapping(B,params=[value]) B ::= 'b' [Other] @value; @enum Mode ::= 'x'; @enum Other ::= 'x'; }
